binomial_interval: two-sided equal-tailed exact Clopper-Pearson; beta quantiles; boundary limits 0 and 1
paired_test: two-sided exact conditional binomial McNemar; FP | PF+FP ~ Binomial(discordants,0.5); discordants=0 -> p=1
p_adjustment: none; pointwise secondary p-values, no multiplicity-controlled confirmatory interpretation

bootstrap.draw: 32 clusters uniformly with replacement per resample
bootstrap.indices: shared across all 15 seed/checkpoint rows, preserving both repeats and all policies
bootstrap.cluster_order: ascending initial_id; validate unique physical fingerprint and env_seed
bootstrap.conditional_denominators: recompute Base successes/failures in every resample
bootstrap.zero_denominator: exclude that resample only for undefined metric; record valid/invalid counts, never redraw

restrictions: CPU only; no model/env import, rollout, training, checkpoint change, or final blind access
